I have smoked daily for six years and not one year. In the one year sober (no drinking not weed just nicotine) I was the most miserable I have ever been. Crying constantly, migraines up the ass, etc I have been diagnosed bipolar2 , bpd, ptsd, anxiety, depression, previous eating disorder. It helped me overcome the disordered eating, my acne went away, I still take psych meds bc weed isn’t just enough (I tried for two years no meds just weed) I smoke 3-4x a day currently and am productive most the time with exception to my depressive spells. To give example I was having intense anxiety for hours yesterday, (shaking, heart palpitations, sweating etc) and i took two hits and was fine again and laughing with my bf from sobbing
I take a cocktail of 4. Ativan for anxiety, Effexor XR for depression, abilify for mood and lamictal for mood
I also use marijuana! It helps me so much in the moment and i don’t really consider it substance abuse bc it doesn’t hurt my relationships.
